RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men. Because the panel selected one male candidate over another, there is no viable basis to claim sex discrimination. While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity shortcomings within the bank, it does not indicate bias against you based on your sex. 

The decision likely hinged on qualifications: senior leadership roles in banking often prioritize regulatory governance and executive stakeholder experience over technical modelling depth. Raising the panel’s gender composition would appear meritless and could damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your candidacy for future executive roles.
